title: How being bullied ended up in me being persecuted by the astral police.
content: I was minding my own business in the Mall World school when a group (about 5) of tall men (school's jocks) began to grab me and took me to a random place. They wanted to bully/ torture me, but I ended up destroying my bullies. I ended up being teleported into the office of administrators in the same school. They wanted to interrogate me as to why I did what I did towards the bullies. Rapidly, I found a cup filled with pen(cils). I grabbed the cup and I threw the pen(cils) towards the admins around me. Somehow, the pencils and pens inside the cup flew towards them in a shuriken style, and I escaped from their office. A group of astral police officers began to chase after me and we ended up inside a public restroom. This time the public restroom didn't have 2 exits and the restroom only had 2 stalls with 2 urinals. The dividers of the stalls there was about 6', so it wasn't your average Mall World restroom. Trapped there I didn't know where to escape. The astral police officers had me surrounded. They wanted to reassure me that they wanted to help me. I cried towards the astral police while saying "you're like the school system which favored the bullies and despise short men". At the moment, I said that, I saw them laughing at me. Luckily, I saw another person in the stall next to me. I went under the stall and I took a few lighters from his long coat. I began to attack the astral police by flickering the lighter towards their clothes. Rapidly, I ended up covering their bodies with flames and I managed to escape the officers. Then somehow I ran towards a hotel room and I hide there while the astral police was looking for me. For some reason, the astral police force was as effective as the police in the GTA game. So in an instant, they just went away from me. The people around me inside the hotel room acted as if what I gone through didn't happen in my astral experience and I was forced to fully wake up completely from my dream. Come to think of it, I never went through such an experience. Yes, I have been persecuted by the astral police in undercover clothing before, but I never been bullied and persecuted at the same time.
